verdict.rationale: vLLM's official CLI reference documents an option to 'Print TTFT and throughput statistics after each response'. That implies a first-party, response-by-response terminal interaction mode alongside the server-start command, but no item explicitly names an interactive chat subcommand or describes the session. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an interactive terminal chat command and its usage (model selection, multi-turn behavior), plus any hands-on or community corroboration.
